blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) and the Philippine Children’s Medical Center (PCMC) signed an agreement on the first ever hospital-based learning continuity program in the country for children with long-term health conditions. The memorandum, signed on Monday, Sept. 28, is expected to help eligible patients continue their education while receiving medical care through the Alternative Learning System (ALS).
